item.title: Colder air arrives in Virginia ahead of weekend snow
item.description: Our computer models continue to show the potential for a storm off the coast this weekend. Each model shows a different proximity to the East Coast.

item.title: Marijuana-themed sandwich joint puffs up in Chesterfield
item.description: Sub sandwich chain Cheba Hut is planning to open a Chesterfield shop this summer. Pictured is the company’s pizza sub called the Dank.

item.title: Neighbors feel trapped days after Virginia ice storm: What's being done to help?
item.description: Some Central Virginia neighbors say they remain trapped at home Thursday as neighborhood streets stay iced over 4 days after Sunday's winter storm hit Virginia.
